name: Longsword
description: A classic martial sword with a long blade and grip suitable for one or two hands.

name: Shortbow
description: A compact ranged weapon firing arrows; common among scouts, rangers, and skirmishers.

name: Leather Armor
description: Stiffened, boiled leather plates fit comfortably for stealthy work or extended travel.

name: Chain Mail
description: Interlocking metal rings include a layer of quilted fabric underneath to prevent chafing and to cushion blows.

name: Shield
description: Wood or metal carried in one hand. Wielding a shield increases your AC by 2.

name: Healer's Kit
description: Bandages, salves, and splints. As a Utilize action, expend one use to stabilize a creature with 0 HP without making a Wisdom (Medicine) check.

name: Rope, Hempen (50 ft)
description: Standard adventurer's rope. Useful for climbing, binding, and improvised solutions.

name: Torch
properties: Sheds bright light in 20-foot radius and dim light in 20 more feet for 1 hour
description: A wooden stick wrapped at one end with cloth soaked in pitch.

name: Bag of Holding
properties: Holds up to 500 pounds of contents
Always weighs 15 pounds regardless of contents
Internal extradimensional space — placing the bag inside another extradimensional space tears it open
description: A capacious magical sack that holds far more than its size suggests. Treasure of all shapes and sizes can vanish inside without strain.

name: Longsword, +1
properties: +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls
description: A finely-forged longsword humming with magic. The bonus is reflected on attack and damage rolls when wielded.
